long_description:
Coverage Cat, the AI-native insurance broker, fixes your coverage limits and finds cheaper premiums. 

We provide both AI and human support so you can get fast answers on your policy and quickly get a response from a human agent so you can protect you assets or close on a new home. 

The AI-first approach drives core search, support and shopping experiences to ensure you get the best prices with the correct coverage.
